detail.title: Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds
detail.question: What is the theoretical relationship between predictive information and thermodynamic dissipation in nonequilibrium systems with finite or noisy memory?
detail.reason: This project aligns with the enforced predictive_dissipation topic, addressing the core objective of linking predictive capability to thermodynamic cost, while respecting the current blocked status of the thermodynamic_memory domain.
